mechanism: Armodafinil may increase buprenorphine metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing buprenorphine levels; combined CNS effects of both agents may cause additive sedation or stimulation effects.
action: Monitor for decreased opioid efficacy and CNS effects; consider buprenorphine dose adjustment if armodafinil is initiated or discontinued; counsel patient on additive CNS effects.
